headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Munsif Daily / Telangana Today / The Hindu
bullets_en: Munawar Zama addresses Vidhana Soudha on National Education Day.
Ponguleti directs Collectors to clear pending 22-A land applications in Telangana.
Keralam Chief Minister to present Ezhuthachan Puraskaram on November 16.
Bulldozer knocks at Abhishek Banerjee’s door: makeshift structures removed.
P. Sanal Mohan resigns from KCHR executive council.
bullets_ur: Munawar Zama ne National Education Day par Vidhana Soudha se khitab kiya.
Ponguleti ne Collectors ko Telangana mein 22-A ki pending land applications clear karne ki hidayat de di
Keralam ke Wazir-e-Ala 16 November ko Ezhuthachan Puraskaram pesh karein ge.
Abhishek Banerjee ke ghar tak pohncha bulldozer: aarzi tameeraat hata di gayeen
P. Sanal Mohan ne istifa de diya.
